sources.entry: rvc-mac - Ribose VPN Client macOS Menu App.

summary.one_liner: A macOS menu bar GUI app for the rvd VPN daemon, part of the Ribose VPN Client (rvc-mac) project.
summary.what_it_does: The README describes rvc-mac as a GUI for the rvd daemon. It is built in Xcode using an rvcmac.xcworkspace file. Build setup requires installing json-c via Homebrew and fetching git submodules. The README gives no details on VPN protocols, configuration options, or day-to-day usage. It also does not explain how the app connects to rvd beyond calling it a GUI for that daemon.
use_cases: Controlling the rvd VPN daemon from a Mac GUI
Building a macOS VPN client app from source
Studying a Mac menu app that wraps a daemon
how_to_run: Press cmd+R to build and run
stack: Objective-C or Swift (Xcode project, inferred from rvcmac.xcworkspace)
notable: Acts as a GUI front end for the separate rvd daemon
Uses Xcode workspace with git submodules for dependencies
Part of the Ribose cryptode-mac project
caveats: The README is minimal and does not describe features, screenshots, or supported macOS versions
Requires the rvd daemon, which the README does not supply
Build needs Homebrew and Xcode, and submodules must be fetched
